breakdown.reason: The generated specification still explicitly instructs the use of the Dittus-Boelter correlation (Nu = 0.023 Re^0.8 Pr^0.4), which is a turbulent correlation, despite correctly identifying the flow as laminar (Re=800). The ground truth resolves this by replacing it with an appropriate laminar correlation (e.g., Nu=3.66). The agent failed to fix this inconsistency.
